issue.title: Ordinary task @route capture honors project_name_aliases instead of creating a stray note

task_type_fields.proposal: Teach ordinary task `@route` capture to honor `project_name_aliases`, the same way bob-cli-5y's `URL @route` refs, `bob ref create -P`, `bob ref list -P`, and route completion already do through `src/native/parent_notes.rs::resolve_parent`. Repro on bob at 091eda9: `bob capture -d 'fix the thing @bob-cli'` prints `would capture bob-cli.md` (a new note), while `bob capture -d 'https://example.com/essay @bob-cli'` files under `bob.md` via the alias. Route completion offers `bob · aka bob-cli`, so accepting an alias-matched completion for a task then silently creates a stray note. Proposed in plan:202610/ref_tasks_live_with_parent.md closeout step 5 ("alias-aware ordinary @route capture").
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-5y listed it as a non-goal ("ordinary task @route capture does not learn aliases in this epic"): ordinary `@route` may create new notes, so alias matching there needs its own rules for when an alias wins over creating a note, plus Bob Mac Capture preview parity.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5y's plan listed alias-aware ordinary @route capture as a closeout follow-up, and the URL-vs-task inconsistency now lets an alias completion create a stray note.
